name: 先天性表皮水疱症（接合部型）

summary.text: A group of inherited epidermolysis bullosa characterized by involvement of the skin and mucous membranes, and is defined by the formation of blistering lesions between the epidermis and the dermis at the lamina lucida level of the cutaneous basement membrane zone and by healing of lesions with atrophy and/or exuberant granulation tissue formation.
summary.evidence: A group of inherited epidermolysis bullo

symptoms.text: involvement of the skin and mucous membranes
symptoms.evidence: involvement of the skin and mucous
